status: Post hoc re-analysis (roadmap Steps 6 and 6b), written on 2026-11-08 after every v1 and v2 result had been seen. Its families and rules are labelled a re-analysis, not a pre-registered test; v3's own pre-registration is SPEC_V3.md.
verdict_rule: better if the upper end of the 95% interval for P_L(choice) - P_L(reference) is below 0, worse if its lower end is above 0, otherwise tie (Newcombe hybrid score interval for two proportions; the interval of the difference from the all-placement average for that reference)
m6_rule: M6 (retained / original gain) is reported only when the 95% interval of the original gain P_L(fixed) - P_L(true-model choice) has its lower end at or above half its estimate; the absolute retained gain is always reported
